title: compute_thumbprint(mixed-type dict) raised TypeError; SPEC promises ValueError
replay_message: V009 REPRODUCED: compute_thumbprint(mixed-type dict) raised TypeError (TypeError("'<' not supported between instances of 'int' and 'str'")) — SPEC promises ValueError
fix_hint: Catch TypeError at thumbprint()/canonical_json() and re-raise as ValueError, OR guard against non-str keys before canonical_json.

title: compute_thumbprint(RSA missing 'e') silently produced thumbprint; RFC 7638 §3.2 requires raising
harness_category_meaning: V007 reproducer: recognized kty missing required member
replay_message: V007 REPRODUCED: compute_thumbprint({'kty': 'RSA', 'n': 'abc'}) on missing-required member kty='RSA' SILENTLY produced a thumbprint — RFC 7638 §3.2 requires the call to raise
fix_hint: Define MISSING_REQUIRED_MEMBERS(ValueError); raise in filter loop when a recognized kty is missing a required member.

title: verify(depth=470) leaked RecursionError; verify() must catch and return False (DoS surface)
replay_message: V002 REPRODUCED: verify(depth=470) leaked RecursionError (RecursionError('maximum recursion depth exceeded in __instancecheck__')) — verify() must catch RecursionError and return False (DoS surface)
fix_hint: Broaden verify()'s except tuple to include (RecursionError, MemoryError); or wrap entire verify() body in try/except Exception: return False.

title: canonical_json({True: 1}) produced '{true:1}' (unquoted key) — invalid JSON output

replay_message: V010 REPRODUCED: canonical_json({True: 1}) = '{true:1}' contains an unquoted identifier as a key — invalid JSON (SPEC promises valid JSON output)
